meta.holding: Each scoring quarter is held from the month-end two months after the quarter-end to the month-end five months after it (60-day reporting lag), e.g. the 31-Mar-2021 row is held 31-May-2021 to 31-Aug-2021. Stock prices are the lagged prices recorded in the supporting workbook; index levels are NSE daily closes on the same dates.

xgboost.label: ZENOJAS XGBoost (trained to Dec-2020)
xgboost.status: Regenerated end to end from the XGBoost model (seed 42) fitted on the supporting workbook's 64 training quarters and frozen; every quarter shown is after the training cut-off.

bilstm.label: ZENOJAS BiLSTM (trained to Dec-2020)
bilstm.status: Regenerated end to end from bi_lstm_top200_xform_16qtr.keras and the supporting workbook; every quarter shown is after the training cut-off.
